name: Summertime Saga
source:
Set in a small suburban town, a young man finishing up High school and soon enlisting into College is struck by the death of his father. The mysterious circumstances of the death are only the beginning of his problems, as he learns that his family is in debt to a group of shady criminals. Adding to the list of problems, our young hero needs to save enough money before his College semester begins and find a date for prom night!

[From https://wiki.summertimesaga.com]
translation:
故事发生在一座郊区小镇。高中毕业、即将升入大学的年轻人遭遇了父亲去世的打击。父亲死亡的神秘情况只是麻烦的开始：他发现家人欠下一群可疑罪犯的债。除此之外，这位年轻英雄还需要在大学学期开始前挣够钱，并为舞会找到约会对象！

[来源：[url=https://wiki.summertimesaga.com]SummerTime Saga Wiki[/url]]
